subtopics.definition: Use when sign-in fails specifically because Spotify rejects, cannot verify, or asks the user to replace their phone number; use general_login when the failure is not tied to phone-number sign-in.
subtopics.name: Phone-number sign-in failures

subtopics.definition: Use when the complaint specifically concerns a rejected or forgotten password, password reset, or missing account-recovery option; use general_login for sign-in failures without a stated password or recovery issue.
subtopics.name: Password or recovery access

subtopics.definition: Use when Spotify logs the user out unexpectedly or repeatedly, including after closing or updating the app; use general_login when the complaint only says the user cannot sign in.
subtopics.name: Unexpected sign-outs

subtopics.definition: Use when account creation fails or a named alternate sign-in method such as Google, Facebook, or a browser/app login path is unavailable; use phone_login for phone-number-specific failures and general_login for unspecified sign-in failures.
subtopics.name: Signup or sign-in method unavailable

subtopics.definition: Use when the user clearly cannot access or sign in to an account but gives no specific phone-number, password/recovery, unexpected-logout, signup, or alternate-authentication cause.
subtopics.name: Unspecified login failure

subtopics.definition: Use for access-topic complaints that do not clearly identify a login, signup, password, recovery, sign-out, or authentication-method problem.
subtopics.name: Vague access complaint

subtopics.definition: Use when a complaint specifically says free users cannot choose, change, skip, or play a desired song, or are limited in how often they can do so; use playback_controls for seeking, repeating, shuffling, or queue controls.
subtopics.name: Song selection and skipping limits

subtopics.definition: Use when a complaint specifically identifies seek/rewind/forward, repeat/loop, shuffle, or queue/play-order controls as unavailable or premium-only, rather than difficulty choosing or skipping tracks.
subtopics.name: Premium-gated playback controls

subtopics.definition: Use for complaints about subscription cost, charges, discounts, gift-card payment, or subscribing or renewing; do not use for complaints that only describe premium-gated app features.
subtopics.name: Price, payment, or subscription problems

subtopics.definition: Use when the review says generally that the app or many/basic features require premium, but does not identify a specific restricted control or a payment, price, or subscription-account problem.
subtopics.name: Broad premium paywall complaint

subtopics.definition: Use for billing-topic complaints that are too vague to assign to a specific feature restriction, broad paywall complaint, or price, payment, or subscription problem.
subtopics.name: Other or unclear billing complaint

subtopics.definition: Use when a specific song, artist, album, podcast, or other catalog item is absent, removed, restricted, or unavailable; do not use for lyrics missing from an otherwise available song.
subtopics.name: Missing or removed content

subtopics.definition: Use when lyrics are missing, fail to load, are inaccessible, mistimed, or incorrect for a song; do not use for the song itself being unavailable.
subtopics.name: Lyrics availability or accuracy

subtopics.definition: Use when users cannot find a desired song or artist through search, browsing, or discovery tools, excluding complaints specifically about personalized recommendations.
subtopics.name: Search and discovery

subtopics.definition: Use when algorithmic recommendations, DJ selections, or suggested tracks are poor, repetitive, unwanted, or missing; do not use for difficulty searching the catalog.
subtopics.name: Recommendations and curation

subtopics.definition: Use when a complaint concerns catalog, lyrics, search, or discovery but is too vague to assign to a more specific subtopic, or does not clearly describe a product-actionable issue.
subtopics.name: General catalog complaint

subtopics.definition: Downloaded content cannot be found or played without a network connection; use this rather than download failures when the complaint is about offline access to content already downloaded.
subtopics.name: Downloaded music unavailable offline

subtopics.definition: The app will not start, complete, or offer downloads, or the user cannot download the desired content; use this rather than offline playback when the issue is getting content downloaded in the first place.
subtopics.name: Downloads fail or are unavailable

subtopics.definition: Previously downloaded content is deleted, disappears, or must be downloaded again, rather than remaining saved for offline use.
subtopics.name: Downloads disappear or reset

subtopics.definition: The complaint concerns selecting, removing, locating, or storing downloads (including SD-card behavior), rather than whether downloading or offline playback works.
subtopics.name: Download management or storage

subtopics.definition: The review mentions downloads or offline listening but does not specify a concrete failure that fits the other subtopics.
subtopics.name: Other or unclear downloads complaint

subtopics.definition: Use when the review expresses dislike, calls the app bad or useless, or threatens to leave without identifying a specific product problem.
subtopics.name: Unspecified negative appraisal

subtopics.definition: Use when the reviewer specifically blames a new, latest, or ongoing update for making the app worse, without naming a distinct functional failure.
subtopics.name: Update made app worse

subtopics.definition: Use when the reviewer explicitly says the app does not work or mentions bugs, rather than giving only a general negative appraisal.
subtopics.name: App not working

subtopics.definition: Use when the reviewer objects that Spotify content or conduct insults or disrespects their religion; do not use for generic complaints about content or app quality.
subtopics.name: Religious disrespect

subtopics.definition: Use when the reviewer specifically objects to the app collecting personal information, rather than describing general distrust or control concerns.
subtopics.name: Personal information concerns

subtopics.definition: Use when the reviewer explicitly calls Spotify greedy or money-hungry, rather than merely saying the app is bad or inconvenient.
subtopics.name: Greedy or money-focused

subtopics.definition: Audio starts but then stops, pauses, cuts out, or fails to advance unexpectedly; use this rather than playback_start when playback initially cannot begin.
subtopics.name: Playback stops or pauses

subtopics.definition: The requested music or podcast will not begin or resume, or the app reports a connection problem preventing playback; use playback_stops when audio began and later stopped.
subtopics.name: Cannot start or continue playback

subtopics.definition: The app itself will not open or load, freezes, lags, or crashes, rather than only audio stopping while the app remains usable.
subtopics.name: App fails, freezes, or crashes

subtopics.definition: Playback occurs but the selected content is replaced by a different track or the audio has incorrect volume, missing elements, or degraded sound quality; use playback_start if no audio plays.
subtopics.name: Wrong or distorted audio

subtopics.definition: The complaint indicates a playback-related technical problem but lacks enough detail to assign it to stopping, failure to start, app stability, or wrong or distorted audio.
subtopics.name: Other or unspecified playback problem

subtopics.definition: The user cannot locate or access a way to contact support, rather than complaining that support failed to respond after contact.
subtopics.name: Cannot find support

subtopics.definition: The user says support or the company did not reply, ignored them, or provided no information, rather than describing difficulty finding a contact channel.
subtopics.name: No or delayed response

subtopics.definition: The user makes a vague support-related complaint or comment without specifying an access or response problem.
subtopics.name: General support complaint

subtopics.definition: Use for complaints that ads are too frequent, too long, repetitive, or interrupt listening; do not use for non-ad playback interruptions or generic complaints.
subtopics.name: Ad frequency and interruptions

subtopics.definition: Use when controls such as skip, seek, rewind, repeat, or playback options are unavailable or difficult to access, rather than when Spotify plays the wrong content.
subtopics.name: Missing or restricted playback controls

subtopics.definition: Use when playback ignores the chosen song or playlist, adds or repeats unwanted tracks, shuffles unexpectedly, or disrupts the queue; do not use for missing playback controls.
subtopics.name: Unexpected selection or queue behavior

subtopics.definition: Use for complaints that the layout, tabs, home screen, or navigation changed or makes features harder to find, excluding specific playlist-management difficulties.
subtopics.name: Interface and navigation changes

subtopics.definition: Use for problems creating or browsing playlists, managing liked or saved songs, or handling library limits, rather than general interface redesign or playback behavior.
subtopics.name: Playlist and library management

subtopics.definition: Use when a complaint expresses a usability problem in general but does not identify a specific actionable issue covered by another subtopic.
subtopics.name: Other or unspecified usability complaint
